name: print-blockage-stopper
description: Automated maintenance prints for any network printer (especially pigment printers like Canon imagePROGRAF, Epson SureColor, HP DesignJet, etc.). Sends a small test image on a configurable schedule (default: every 3 days) to keep all ink channels flowing and prevent costly pigment clogs and cleaning cycles. Features: multi-printer support, network printer discovery, per-printer schedules, smart skip (won't print if the printer was recently used), preset test images for 4/6/8/11/12-colour printers, custom image upload, notifications (webhook, email, Home Assistant), and a modern React dashboard with dark mode.

paths.name: Data / Logs
paths.description: Persistent storage for printer config, logs, uploads, and CUPS state.

paths.name: Unraid Notifications
paths.description: Mount Unraid's notification script to get alerts on print failures. Leave default for standard Unraid installs.

ports.name: Dashboard
ports.description: Web dashboard for managing printers, schedules, and test images.

ports.name: CUPS Web UI
ports.description: CUPS print server interface for advanced monitoring.

variables.name: Printer IP Address
variables.description: (Optional) IP address of a printer to auto-add on first boot. You can also add printers from the dashboard after starting the container.

variables.name: Default Print Schedule
variables.description: Default cron expression for new printers. Can be customised per-printer in the dashboard. Default: every 3 days at 10 AM.

variables.name: Default Paper Size
variables.description: Default paper size for new printers (e.g., A4, Letter, A3). Can be changed per-printer.

variables.name: Default Skip Hours
variables.description: Default hours to skip maintenance print if printer was recently used. Adjustable per-printer in the dashboard.

variables.name: Connection Type
variables.description: Default connection type for new printers: 'ipp' (recommended) or 'socket' (port 9100).

variables.name: Webhook URL
variables.description: (Optional) URL for print success/failure notifications. Works with Slack incoming webhooks, Discord webhooks, ntfy.sh, or any endpoint accepting JSON POST.

variables.name: Printer Port
variables.description: Default port for socket connections (only used when Connection Type is 'socket').
